MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY
Cole Street, east side, from 20 feet to 45 feet south of Parnassus Avenue (Supervisor District 8)
(Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Kenya Wheeler, [staff email removed — see the order], Monica
Munowitch, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to convert a portion of the existing 2-hour time-limited parking, except vehicles with area J
permits, to General Metered Parking on the east side of the 1000 block of Cole Street. Residents and
merchants adjacent to the proposed General Metered Parking space will continue to be eligible for
Area J permits.

Public Comments: No comments.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
